set.body: Define and test explicit boundary policies for LISA filtering. boundary = neuroim2 should faithfully wrap neuroim2::bilateral_filter() behavior; boundary = mask_normalized should exclude out-of-mask neighbors; boundary = lisa2018 should later add paper-style smaller-neighborhood median fallback/discard rules. Document that filtered null and observed maps must use the identical policy.
set.title: LISA: boundary semantics for neuroim2 and mask-aware modes
